simple: Adds or hijacks an OAuth app in Microsoft 365 or another SaaS — and keeps access to email and files even after a password change.
analogy: Gets a permanent pass “from a contractor” that isn’t revoked when the locks are changed.
quote: We changed the password, but the attacker still has access to the mailbox
questions: Who can authorize apps to access corporate data?
